nodes.label: Monaco Clipboard Paste Workflow
nodes.rationale: Monaco ignores programmatic .value assignment and JS-dispatched KeyboardEvents, so the only reliable path is OS-level clipboard write plus accessibility-permitted Cmd+A/Cmd+V/Cmd+S keystrokes, with a ~3s wait because Monaco applies pastes asynchronously and saving early produces an empty file.

nodes.label: React Canvas Synthetic Event Rejection
nodes.source_location: What Framer will not let automation do
nodes.rationale: Framer's React canvas rejects synthetic mouse events on many widgets (drag-drop, variant switching, page settings); workable interactions need the full pointer+mouse event chain or OS-level coordinate clicks, and non-automatable flows should be handed to the human with step-by-step selectors.

nodes.label: Publish Button Mount Dependency
nodes.rationale: The Publish button is only mounted in the DOM when a page is selected in the Pages tab and its React handler ignores JS-dispatched clicks, making this the most common silent-failure trap in Framer automation.

edges.source_location: the React handler on that button ignores JS-dispatched clicks
